git.note: The source round files are read at the checked-out revision above; their hashes are also checked against protocol_freeze.json.

main_runs_table.test_use: Already-reported Test RMSE/MAE scalar columns only; no Test prediction file, target or inference.

missing_input_policy: No missing input is filled by retraining, borrowing another repeat, or silently using another version.

original_round_source_commit_check.analysis_decision: Continue the three independent analyses: (1) the main_runs.csv scalars and per-run Valid predictions used by A/B are unaffected by these two post-freeze edits; (2) the buggy _seed_diffs code is present in both the frozen hash version and the checked-out source, so the A correction is not sensitive to the stale hashes; (3) no Test prediction is used.
original_round_source_commit_check.post_freeze_difference_explanation: protocol_freeze.json was written before the final round commit. Two code hashes are therefore stale relative to the checked-out source at 4a393476: dissect_tables.py changed cross_repeat to read compact_selection['selected'] instead of ['compact']; dissect_intervene.py gained an --out-tag option for path_loo_compact.json. Neither change touches _seed_diffs, contrast_table, the per-run records, or the Valid/Test scalar columns used here. The actual source at the recorded commit is used and no alternate code version is substituted.
